description: This file defines the TaskQueue class used for managing and executing asynchronous tasks in a FIFO order within the GuzzleHttpomise namespace. It provides functionality for adding tasks, running the task queue, and managing shutdown behavior.

classes.name: TaskQueue
classes.description: A class that manages a queue of asynchronous tasks, executing them in FIFO order and handling shutdown procedures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the task queue, optionally registering a shutdown function to run remaining tasks on script exit.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the task queue is empty.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new callable task to the queue.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes all tasks in the queue sequentially.

methods.name: disableShutdown
methods.description: Disables automatic running of remaining tasks when the script exits.
